verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: After esc (pause) and click:btn-restart, the event 'restart' fires and score/lives/timer reset, but mode stays 'paused' and the game does not resume.
verdicts.expected: Restart level resets the level and the game is running again straight away (section 7), so mode should be 'playing'.

verdicts.title: Paused game with Resume button reported as frozen (false positive)
verdicts.observed: After pause and Restart, the state stays paused for 30 waits. The pause menu with Resume and Restart is still available, so the player can act.
verdicts.expected: Pause freezes time by design (section 7), and the Resume button is available. The real defect is that Restart leaves the game paused, which candidate 0 already captures.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays 0/5 after collecting a coin during a dash
verdicts.observed: dash-down collects a coin (coins=1, Score 100), but the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Spikes wrap score to 65136 instead of subtracting 500 and clamping at 0
verdicts.observed: Score 100 steps onto spikes and jumps to 65136 (lives 2, respawn). This looks like a 16-bit unsigned wraparound of 100-500.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score never going below 0, so score should be 0 with one life lost.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-300) after a coin pickup following a spikes wrap
verdicts.observed: Score is 65136 after spikes, then becomes -300 when a coin is collected on the next dash.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and only spikes or a restart may reduce it. Spikes should have clamped the score at 0, and a coin should add 100.

verdicts.title: Toast covers the pause menu Resume button
verdicts.observed: With the 'Key collected' toast visible, pausing shows btn-resume with top=false, so a click at its centre does not reach the button.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable, so nothing (including a toast) may cover Resume.
